text:
Maya: ok fantasy heads — playoffs start next week, who are we benching for the semis? 
Ethan: lol the eternal question. I have Cook or D. Adams. leaning Cook because of weather. 
Priya: @Maya whoever benches Adams owes the channel coffee :coffee: 
Jorge: I’d bench Cook vs PIT. Their run D has been weirdly good. Start Adams. 
Devon: Quick poll — bench Cook, bench Adams, flip a coin? 
Maya: small poll pls: 
Maya: 1) Bench Cook
Maya: 2) Bench Adams
Maya: 3) Other (reply with player)
Ethan: 2 for me. Adams has a tougher matchup but has high target share. 
Priya: 3 — I’m starting McKinnon over both (textbook contrarian move). 
Jorge: hahaha Priya always contrarian :eyes: what’s McKinnon’s status? I thought he was limited. 
Priya: questionable tag but listed as probable now per ESPN: https://www.espn.com/fantasy/ 
Devon: if you want hard data, here’s a tiny waiver script I ran to simulate points across matchups: 
```
# quick sim pseudo-output
player,expected_points
Dalvin Cook,12.4
Davante Adams,9.8
Raheem McKinnon,10.5
```
Maya: love the analytics. My gut + sim says Cook sits. Prob bench Cook. 
Ethan: fine, bench Cook. @Priya if McKinnon explodes you’re buying the first round of coffees. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye: 
Priya: deal. if he flops you all owe me memes. 
Jorge: recording consensus: bench Cook. bench-adams voters stand down. 
Devon: also reminder — waiver claims close tonight at 11:59pm PT. don’t forget to lock. 
Maya: thanks team — final lineup swap in 5. gl everyone :trophy:
